sample.task:
(In the Nether Wastes, a strange woman with 9 white tentacles starts to collect some nether wart)

Female Ghast: "Okay, that should be enough for a Nether Wart sandwich!" (putting a hand on her belly) "Oh! Calm down, little ones. I want all nine of you to enjoy a nice snack."

([player] is walking around when he comes across the female Ghast)

[player]: "Oh my god. You're a Ghast, aren't you?"

([player] climbs along one of the female Ghast's tentacles and onto her left hand)

Female Ghast: (to herself) "Okay, now I just need to make the sandwiches."

(The female Ghast flies over to her home with [player] still on the female Ghast's left hand. After some time, the female Ghast arrives at her home)

Female Ghast: (to herself) "Okay, I finally made it." (looking at her belly) "Alright, little ones. Are you ready to enjoy a Nether Wart sandwich."

[player]: "Hello?"

(The female Ghast recoils in shock, and then her water suddenly breaks - which quickly evaporates due to the intense heat of the Nether)

[player]: (noticing the female Ghast's pain) "Are you okay?"

(One of the female Ghast's babies falls out of her womb, levitating off the ground. The baby Ghast was much larger than a regular human, as if it could squash [player] in an instant)

Female Ghast: (to herself) "One down, eight to go."
sample.chosen:
[player]: "Whoa, that's a big baby! I didn't know Ghasts gave birth like this. Do you need any help?"

Female Ghast: (surprised) "You're not going to attack me? Most players I've encountered have tried to harm me or my kind."

[player]: "No, I'm not here to cause trouble. I'm actually quite fascinated by this. I've never seen a Ghast give birth before. Is there anything I can do to assist you?"

Female Ghast: (relieved) "Well, I could use some help keeping the babies calm while I deliver the rest. They can be quite a handful, even when they're newborns."

[player]: "Sure, I can try to help. How do I keep them calm?"

Female Ghast: "Just talk to them softly and maybe gently touch their tentacles. They respond well to soothing voices and gentle touches."

[player]: "Alright, I'll do my best." (turns to the baby Ghast) "Hey there, little one. You're a big fellow, aren't you? It's okay, I'm here to help your mom. Just relax and enjoy the ride."

(The baby Ghast seems to calm down a bit, its large eyes following [player]'s movements)

Female Ghast: (smiling) "Thank you, that's very kind of you. I appreciate your help."

(As the female Ghast continues to deliver her babies, [player] helps keep them calm and entertained, creating an unexpected bond between a player and a Ghast family in the harsh Nether Wastes.)
